code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    top_cells = {(r, c) for r in range(min(5, h)) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)}
    comps = []
    while top_cells:
        start = top_cells.pop()
        q = [start]
        comp = {start}
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in top_cells:
                    top_cells.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    obj = max(comps, key=lambda cells: max(c for r,c in cells))
    bottom = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(6,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h-6)]
    minr, maxr = min(r for r,c,v in bottom), max(r for r,c,v in bottom)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c,v in bottom), max(c for r,c,v in bottom)
    for r,c,v in bottom:
        out[r-6][c] = v
    ominr,omaxr=min(r for r,c in obj),max(r for r,c in obj)
    ominc,omaxc=min(c for r,c in obj),max(c for r,c in obj)
    dy = (minr-6-1)-omaxr
    # Align bounding-box centers; integer grids in these tasks have matching odd widths.
    dx = (minc+maxc-ominc-omaxc)//2
    color = grid[next(iter(obj))[0]][next(iter(obj))[1]]
    for r,c in obj:
        rr,cc=r+dy-6,c+dx
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
